purpose: Reconstruct internally reconciled model-side national labour compensation, gross value added, household disposable cash income, realized household consumption and net saving before empirical comparison.

modelSource.currencyBasis: each fictional country's local nominal currency

notEquivalentTo: ILOSTAT total labour income including self-employed labour income
firm payroll proxy workers times current wage

wagesSettled.stockFlowBridge: closing wages payable = opening wages payable + accrued employee compensation - settled wages

gvaBasicPriceProxy.productionFormula: sales revenue + change in finished-inventory book value - intermediate input consumption at book value
gvaBasicPriceProxy.incomeFormula: employee compensation accrued + sales revenue - cost of goods sold
gvaBasicPriceProxy.valuationWarning: transaction sales use realized prices while unsold finished inventory is retained at book cost

gdpMarketPriceProxy.formula: GVA basic-price proxy + consumption taxes + import tariffs
notEquivalentTo: complete SNA GDP at market prices

cashDisposableHouseholdIncome.formula: cash wages settled + unemployment transfers - income taxes paid
notEquivalentTo: SNA disposable income with all property income, social contributions and pension adjustments

realizedHouseholdConsumptionPurchaserOut.formula: household consumption_expense debit + domestic consumption taxes paid
realizedHouseholdConsumptionPurchaserOut.consumptionExpenseComposition: domestic goods purchases + consumer-import base payment + consumer-import tariff

netHouseholdSavingFlowProxy.formula: cash disposable household income - realized household consumption purchaser outlay
netHouseholdSavingFlowProxy.financingResidual: household cash change - net household saving flow proxy

semanticGaps.externalRole: labour-income component imputed for self-employed workers in the ILO labour-income-share concept
SNA adjustment linking household disposable income, consumption and net saving
components of internationally comparable household disposable or adjusted disposable income
semanticGaps.modelStatus: not comprehensively represented on the household income boundary

semanticGaps.externalRole: financial-intermediation and government non-market value added
semanticGaps.modelStatus: not reconstructed as output in the firm GVA proxy
no explicit monthly depreciation flow in the reconstruction

allowedUse: future empirical gap comparison with explicit semantic flags

executionHardGates: firm and household labour accruals reconcile
wage payable and receivable stock-flow bridges reconcile
finished- and input-inventory stock-flow bridges reconcile
production- and income-side GVA proxies reconcile
household cash change reconciles to settlement postings
cash disposable income reconciles to household and macro fields
realized consumption reconciles across settlement and general ledger
product taxes reconcile to fiscal and international subsystems
all semantic gaps explicitly registered without imputation
exact replay and hard accounting health pass
